title: The latest signal
overview: Today’s index contains 240 recent records. The strongest signals span Consciousness / philosophy, Quantum physics, Neuroscience. Treat the ranking as a reading priority, not a verdict: preprints and ambitious theoretical claims still require independent scrutiny.

items.title: A Transdisciplinary Science of Information within the Organogram of Consciousness
items.why_it_matters: Information transcends the traditional disciplines of physics, psychology, cosmology, and biology, yet remains connected to them through Zero-Point Energy. Although the origins of space, time, and matter are known, the when and how of Information’s emergence remain elusive.

items.title: Quantum tomography of fermion pairs in e + e − collisions: Longitudinal beam polarization effects
items.why_it_matters: We present a quantum tomography study of fermion pair production at future $e^+e^-$ colliders, emphasizing how longitudinal beam polarization controls the two-qubit spin density matrix. We study the processes $e^+ e^- \to t\bar{t},\ e^+e^-\to μ^+μ^-$ and Bhabha scattering $e^+e^-\to e^+e^-$, representing the mass threshold behavior, the $Z$ pole resonance and the $s/t$-channel interplay.

items.title: Body in memory: the role of bodily self-consciousness in episodic memory and autonoetic consciousness
items.why_it_matters: Episodic memory (EM) enables the conscious recollection of personally experienced events, including contextual features such as visual, auditory and emotional details. However, the role of bodily signals has been largely neglected in EM, although the observer's body provides a rich bodily context during the encoding, storage and recall of events, and has recently been associated with a bodily form of self-consciousness (bodily self-consciousness; BSC).
